build_panoptic_fpn_model: build a PanopticFPN meta-architecture model from a detectron2 config for panoptic segmentation
run_panoptic_fpn_inference: run PanopticFPN inference on batched image inputs with optional postprocessing
combine_semantic_and_instance_outputs: combine semantic segmentation results with instance detection outputs into panoptic segmentation
configure_panoptic_fpn_thresholds: configure PanopticFPN with custom overlap, area, and score thresholds for combining outputs
test_panoptic_fpn_training: test PanopticFPN forward pass in training mode with semantic and instance ground truth
